preconditions: Lamp at room temperature, switched off for at least [soak time in min]
setup: Mount the lamp at the entrance port of an integrating sphere
Connect the lamp to a bench supply set to [supply voltage in V]
steps: Switch the lamp on and note the switch-on time
Record luminous flux against time for at least 5 s
response.expected_result: Luminous flux reaches at least 400 lm no later than 2.0 s after switch-on.
response.pass_criterion: Luminous flux >= 400 lm at a time <= 2.0 s after switch-on; fail otherwise.

response.inspect: The outer surface of the lamp housing, under daylight.
The housing, for a voltage label.
response.pass_condition: A label stating the operating voltage is present on the housing.

response.description: An operator switches the lamp on and off using one hand only.
procedure: Hold the lamp in one hand
Operate the switch with the same hand, on and then off
response.acceptance_criterion: The switch is operated on and off with one hand, with a force of no more than [maximum force in N].

response.inspect: The lamp's mounting interface, and a trial fit on a 35 mm rail or a wall bracket.
response.pass_condition: The lamp mounts on a 35 mm rail or on a wall bracket.
